description: Feature flag percentage rollout comparator inverts bucket calculation (> instead of <), causing 0% rollouts to enable flags for majority of users.
spec_notes: FlagEvaluator must evaluate percentage rollout as bucket < threshold.

"""Targeting rule definition for feature flags."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional


@dataclass
class TargetingRule:
    attribute: str
    operator: str  # "IN", "EQUALS", "PERCENTAGE"
    values: List[Any]
    serve_value: bool

tests.test_feature_flags.py:
from flag_rule import TargetingRule
from evaluator import FlagEvaluator
from client import FeatureFlagClient


def test_default_fallback_value():
    ev = FlagEvaluator("beta_ui", default_value=False, rules=[])
    client = FeatureFlagClient({"beta_ui": ev})
    assert client.is_enabled("beta_ui", {"user_id": "u1"}) is False


def test_user_in_whitelist_segment():
    rule = TargetingRule("country", "IN", ["US", "CA"], True)
    ev = FlagEvaluator("fast_checkout", default_value=False, rules=[rule])
    client = FeatureFlagClient({"fast_checkout": ev})
    assert client.is_enabled("fast_checkout", {"country": "US"}) is True
    assert client.is_enabled("fast_checkout", {"country": "DE"}) is False


def test_percentage_rollout_zero_percent_serves_none():
    # 0% rollout must disable flag for all users
    rule = TargetingRule("user_id", "PERCENTAGE", [0], True)
    ev = FlagEvaluator("experimental", default_value=False, rules=[rule])
    client = FeatureFlagClient({"experimental": ev})
    for uid in ["user_1", "user_2", "user_3", "admin"]:
        assert client.is_enabled("experimental", {"user_id": uid}) is False


def test_percentage_rollout_100_percent_serves_all():
    # 100% rollout must enable flag for all users
    rule = TargetingRule("user_id", "PERCENTAGE", [100], True)
    ev = FlagEvaluator("rollout_full", default_value=False, rules=[rule])
    client = FeatureFlagClient({"rollout_full": ev})
    for uid in ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"]:
        assert client.is_enabled("rollout_full", {"user_id": uid}) is True


def test_targeting_rule_precedence_order():
    # Whitelist rule has priority over general rollout
    r1 = TargetingRule("email", "EQUALS", ["vip@corp.com"], True)
    r2 = TargetingRule("tier", "IN", ["free"], False)
    ev = FlagEvaluator("premium_feature", default_value=False, rules=[r1, r2])
    client = FeatureFlagClient({"premium_feature": ev})
    # VIP user with free tier gets True because r1 matches first
    assert client.is_enabled("premium_feature", {"email": "vip@corp.com", "tier": "free"}) is True
    assert client.is_enabled("premium_feature", {"email": "other@corp.com", "tier": "free"}) is False


def test_missing_flag_returns_false():
    client = FeatureFlagClient({})
    assert client.is_enabled("unregistered", {}) is False
